english.title: Cause / permit taxi to ply for hire / load passengers without authority at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to ply for hire or load passengers

(C)_[without being authorised to do so by the Airport Company]_
(D)_[otherwise than from an authorised standing]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Stansted Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 8(1) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause / permit a taxi to
ply for hire / load passengers
without being authorised to do so
by the Airport Company OR
otherwise than from an authorised standing
at Stansted Airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Byelaw 8(1)(b) provides that it shall not be an offence to load passengers in a public car park or at a distance of more than half a mile from the nearest of such authorised standings or, with the consent of a constable, traffic warden in uniform, or an airport official, at any distance from such authorised standings.
